items.text: Detective and private investigation work in India is mostly document checks, background verification, insurance and corporate inquiries rather than films, and it must stay within privacy and criminal law, so check licensing rules and keep to lawful methods.
The steady work is verification, due diligence and insurance claim checks, done lawfully with written client consent and clear records.
Check current state and central rules, and take legal advice before you offer paid services.
